title: Annual Family Income Certificate
description: Income certificate issued by a Competent Revenue Authority (Tehsildar/Sub-Divisional Magistrate) certifying gross family income not exceeding ₹4,50,000 for the current financial year.

title: Class XII / Higher Secondary Examination Marksheet
description: Original or certified copy of the Class XII marksheet showing student scored above the 80th percentile cut-off for their respective board and stream.

title: Institutional Verification / Bonafide Certificate
description: Bonafide student certificate signed by the Head of the Institution / College Principal confirming enrollment in a regular full-time degree course.

title: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Account Passbook
description: Bank passbook front page displaying student name, IFSC code, account number, and active NPCI mapper Aadhaar linkage for Direct Benefit Transfer.
issuing_authority: Scheduled Commercial Bank / Core Banking Branch

title: Digital Caste Certificate with Nadakacheri RD Number
description: Scheduled Caste certificate issued by the Karnataka Revenue Department featuring a digital RD number verifiable via Nadakacheri portal.
issuing_authority: Revenue Department (Nadakacheri / Atalji Janasnehi Kendra), Govt of Karnataka

title: Revenue Income Certificate (e-Pramaan Patra)
description: Income certificate (Form-F / e-Pramaan Patra) issued by the Tahsildar with digital RD number certifying annual family income below ₹2,50,000.
issuing_authority: Tahsildar / Revenue Department, Govt of Karnataka

title: College Admission Fee Receipt & Study Certificate
description: Current academic year admission confirmation receipt and study certificate verified by the College e-Attestation Officer.

title: Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB) Seeded Bank Passbook
description: Active savings account in student's name linked to Aadhaar number through NPCI mapper for scholarship disbursement.

title: Centralized Counseling Technical Degree Admission Allotment Letter
description: Official seat allotment letter proving admission to 1st year (or 2nd year lateral entry) in an AICTE-approved degree institution through state or central counseling.
issuing_authority: Centralized Admission Authority / KEA / DTE / JoSAA

title: Tehsildar Certified Family Income Certificate
description: Family income certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Tehsildar stating gross annual family income <= ₹8,00,000.

title: Institution Bonafide & Tuition Fee Structure Certificate
description: Certificate issued by the College Principal confirming student is enrolled in full-time AICTE approved degree program and specifying college fee breakup.
issuing_authority: Head of AICTE Approved Institution / Principal

title: Land Ownership Record (Khatauni / RTC / Patta)
description: Certified extract of the land revenue record (Bhoomi RTC in Karnataka, Khatauni in North India) reflecting cultivable land in the applicant farmer's name.

title: Aadhaar Card with e-KYC Verification
description: Aadhaar card of the farmer with completed e-KYC (via OTP or Biometric/Face authentication on PM-KISAN portal).

title: Active DBT-Enabled Bank Account
description: Bank account passbook copy showing active NPCI DBT status for electronic transfer of ₹2,000 quarterly installments.

title: Karnataka Antyodaya, BPL, or APL Ration Card
description: Ration card issued by Karnataka Food & Civil Supplies Department explicitly naming the applicant woman as the household head (Yajamani).
issuing_authority: Department of Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs, Govt of Karnataka

title: Aadhaar Card of Female Household Head (Yajamani)
description: Aadhaar card of the woman applicant matching the name on the family ration card.

title: Aadhaar Card of Husband (if married)
description: Aadhaar card of the husband utilized by Seva Sindhu API to verify that the husband does not pay income tax or file GST.
